verdict.rationale: Pipecat's docs call it an "open source Python framework". A runtime probe confirms the PyPI package pipecat-ai 1.8.1 is BSD-2 licensed OSS that installs and imports. The source is publicly hosted at github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat, including a public changelog. Missing for 10: a first-party statement or LICENSE file in the repo naming the BSD-2 license (the license name comes only from the probe).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
pypi pipecat-ai 1.8.1 (BSD-2 OSS) installs and `import pipecat` succeeds with no key
Pipecat is an open source ecosystem for building voice and multimodal AI
